title: Education in AZE
author: CAVIDABASOV519
selftext: I want to be a game developer in the future. Which university and specialty is recommended to choose (IT)? I also want to study a master's degree abroad, so I need to choose a university accordingly? Which university should I choose, both in my country and abroad? As far as I know, to become a game developer, the specialty in my country must be computer science or information technology, but I don't know which one. I'm not going to translate this article from translate, but I would be happy if you could translate it into Azerbaijani like me. I don't want to translate each one ;((
